Agenda Item
Meeting Date: 10/12/2026 - 7:00 PM
Category: Consolidated Agenda
Type: Action
Subject: 10.4 Contractor Agreement Between Mountain View Los Altos High School District and Ed Theory LLC.
LCAP (Local Control Accountability Plan) Goal:
Enclosure Contractor Agreement, Ed Theory LLC.
File Attachment:
Ed Theory LLC Sch Psych.pdf
Summary: This contract is for Ed Theory LLC, who will provide one bilingual licensed educational school psychologist. The bilingual school psychologist will provide initial and triennial assessments including bilingual assessments, attend IEP meetings, and comply with requests for initial assessments of private school students, for whom we, by law, must assess for suspected disabilities.
Funding: Special Education Funds, up to $122,310.00.
Recommendation: Approve the agreement with Ed Theory LLC, for the 2026 - 2027 school year.
